id: \rLiza: Hello again \PN. Nice to see you.
en: \rLiza: Hello again \PN. Nice to see you.
it: \rPat: Ciao di nuovo, \PN. Che piacere vederti.

id: \rWould you like me to train one of your Pokémon?
en: \rWould you like me to train one of your Pokémon?
it: \rVuoi che alleni uno dei tuoi Pokémon?

id: \rOh? But you only have one with you.
en: \rOh?  But you only have one with you.
it: \rOh? Ma ne hai solo uno con te.

id: \rWhich Pokémon would you like me to raise?
en: \rWhich Pokémon would you like me to raise?
it: \rQuale Pokémon vuoi che alleni?

id: \rFine.
en: \rFine.
it: \rCome vuoi.

id: \rIf you leave me that Pokémon, what are you gonna battle with?
en: \rIf you leave me that Pokémon, what are you gonna battle with?
it: \rSe mi lasci quel Pokémon, con cosa lotterai?

id: \rCome back with some common sense.
en: \rCome back with some common sense.
it: \rTorna quando avrai un po' di buon senso.

id: \rI'll raise your \v[3] for a while.
en: \rI'll raise your \v[3] for a while.
it: \rAllenerò il tuo \v[3] per un po'.

id: \rI can raise two of your Pokémon. Would you like me to raise another?
en: \rI can raise two of your Pokémon. Would you like me to raise another?
it: \rPosso allenare due dei tuoi Pokémon. Vuoi che ne alleni un altro?

id: \rOh? But you only have one Pokémon with you.
en: \rOh? But you only have one Pokémon with you.
it: \rOh? Ma hai un solo Pokémon con te.

id: \rYou can't go off without a Pokémon. Come back another time.
en: \rYou can't go off without a Pokémon. Come back another time.
it: \rNon puoi andartene senza un Pokémon. Torna un'altra volta.

id: \rVery good. Come again.
en: \rVery good. Come again.
it: \rMolto bene. Torna a trovarmi.

id: \rCome back another time.
en: \rCome back another time.
it: \rTorna un'altra volta.

id: \rFine, I'll raise your \v[3] for a while.
en: \rFine, I'll raise your \v[3] for a while.
it: \rVa bene, allenerò il tuo \v[3] per un po'.

id: \rCome back for it later.
en: \rCome back for it later.
it: \rTorna a prenderlo più tardi.

id: \rOh, fine, then.\nCome again.
en: \rOh, fine, then.\nCome again.
it: \rOh, va bene, allora.\nTorna presto.

id: \rHey \PN. How's it going? Your Pokémon got stronger.
en: \rHey \PN. How's it going? Your Pokémon got stronger.
it: \rEhi, \PN. Come va? Il tuo Pokémon è diventato più forte.

id: \rBy level, your \v[3] has grown by about \v[4].
en: \rBy level, your \v[3] has grown by about \v[4].
it: \rIl tuo \v[3] è salito di circa \v[4] livelli.

id: \rDo you want your Pokémon back?
en: \rDo you want your Pokémon back?
it: \rVuoi riprenderti il tuo Pokémon?

id: \rYour Pokémon team is full. Make room, then come see me.
en: \rYour Pokémon team is full. Make room, then come see me.
it: \rLa tua squadra è al completo. Fai spazio e poi torna da me.

id: Which one do you want back?
en: Which one do you want back?
it: Quale vuoi riprenderti?

id: \G\rIf you want your \v[3] back, it will cost $\v[4].
en: \G\rIf you want your \v[3] back, it will cost $\v[4].
it: \G\rSe rivuoi il tuo \v[3], ti costerà $\v[4].

id: \G\rYou don't have enough money...
en: \G\rYou don't have enough money...
it: \G\rNon hai abbastanza soldi...

id: \G\rAwesome\nHere's your Pokémon.
en: \G\rAwesome\nHere's your Pokémon.
it: \G\rFantastico\nEcco il tuo Pokémon.

id: \PN took \v[3] back from Liza.
en: \PN took \v[3] back from Liza.
it: \PN si è ripreso \v[3] da Liza.

id: \rDo you want to take back the other one, too?
en: \rDo you want to take back the other one, too?
it: \rVuoi riprenderti anche l'altro?

id: \rNurse Joy: You should take a break.
en: \rNurse Joy: You should take a break.
it: \rInfermiera Joy: Dovresti prenderti una pausa.

id: \rOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great. Take care now!
en: \rOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great.  Take care now!
it: \rOh, bene! Tu e i tuoi Pokémon avete un ottimo aspetto. Abbi cura di te!

id: \bBrandon is currently out training right now. Try coming back later.
en: \bBrandon is currently out training right now. Try coming back later.
it: \bBrandon al momento è fuori ad allenarsi. Riprova più tardi.

id: \bThrough here you battle Brandon. Are you ready?
en: \bThrough here you battle Brandon. Are you ready?
it: \bDa qui si va a lottare contro Brandon. Sei pronto?

id: \bBrandon will be ready shortly. Come back in a few minutes.
en: \bBrandon will be ready shortly. Come back in a few minutes.
it: \bBrandon sarà pronto a breve. Torna fra qualche minuto.

id: \bYou need a Frontier Pass to battle Brandon.
en: \bYou need a Frontier Pass to battle Brandon.
it: \bTi serve un Pass Lotta per sfidare Brandon.

id: \bAn Aipom stole yours? That's happened a few times actually. It usually goes to the Indigo Plateau after taking something.
en: \bAn Aipom stole yours? That's happened a few times actually. It usually goes to the Indigo Plateau after taking something.
it: \bUn Aipom ti ha rubato il tuo? In effetti è già successo qualche volta. Di solito va all'Altopiano Blu dopo aver preso qualcosa.

id: \bYou have already beat Brandon.
en: \bYou have already beat Brandon.
it: \bHai già battuto Brandon.

id: \bMost people don't get to come to this place. It ocassionaly moves to keep it secret.
en: \bMost people don't get to come to this place. It ocassionaly moves to keep it secret.
it: \bLa maggior parte della gente non riesce a venire in questo posto. Ogni tanto si sposta per restare segreto.
